Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from the first ODI of this series. The hosts kick off the series with a win on their 1000th ODI. The second ODI will be played on Wednesday, 9th February at 1:30 pm IST (8 am GMT). But the build up will begin much in advance. Do join us for that. Till then, Adios and cheers!

Yuzvendra Chahal is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that he felt good, he knew Sundar had taken two wickets in an over and created pressure, and he wanted to do the same. Mentions that he wanted to pitch it up, and maintain the pace. States that the pace was important on this wicket since it would slow up. He did try to bowl according to the wicket. Adds that he wanted to improve since his previous games in South Africa, and he saw his previous games three-four times also he spoke to Rohit Sharma and the coaches who told him ways to improve and he worked on that. States that he knew the batters would go after him if he tossed the deliveries up, but he stuck to his plans.

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India, says he does not believe in a perfect game as a side can’t always be perfect but he believes it was a great effort by everyone. Mentions they could not lose so many wickets with the bat and they could have created more pressure in the middle overs with the ball but the boys were really good. States they want to keep getting better as a team and they should be able to achieve what the team wants, they do not feel they need to change a lot and they just need to challenge themselves to do something different. Also says he was practicing back home, he knew they have a long season and they had a good net session here too and he was confident heading into this game. Admits the pitch had something in it for the bowlers and in this game the toss was important, he though does not want to depend a lot on the toss but he would always want to take advantage if they do win it.

Kieron Pollard, the skipper of West Indies, says losing with 22 overs to spare is a heavy defeat. Adds the batting let them down and they need to improve there. Mentions they need to dig deeper, they have all been guilty of making mistakes but it has been difficult, he credits guys for turning up and he feels the bowlers did well and if they put on runs, they could compete. Reckons the toss is going to be crucial, the ball held in the surface when they batted first and they need to find a way to win in two days' time. Also says Holder bats low as that suits the combination of the team and he has a role to play and they are happy he has been doing well and he hopes he can continue. Ends by saying there are a few positives and they will see what happens in a couple of days.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Suryakumar Yadav is down for a chat. He says things were really clear, he did not tell Hooda anything and he knew he had to stay there till the end and he was confident. Adds he just wants to enjoy the game and it is going very well. Informs about his banter with Pollard. Reckons with the dew coming in, it was difficult for the bowlers to grip but it was about the same as the first innings.

Rohit Sharma and Ishan Kishan got India off to a flier. Rohit scored a half-ton on his return to the side. Then there was a period in play that belonged to the Windies where Joseph bowled brilliantly along with Akeal Hosein and the visitors managed to get 4 quick wickets. Hooda and Yadav though ensured there were no surprises and played responsibly to take their side over the line.

Quite a comprehensive win for the Indians and they have taken a 1-0 lead in the series. They were on song right from the start. After winning the toss and electing to field, their bowlers, especially their spinners ran through the batting line-up of West Indies. Had it not been for Holder’s half-ton, West Indies would have been bundled out for around 110-120. His knock gave some respectability to the score but by no way that was going to be enough.

FOUR! Suryakumar Yadav finishes things off in style! A flatter ball, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav opens the face of the bat and steers it past point for a boundary. India win by 6 wickets! They go 1-0 up!
Very full, on middle. Deepak Hooda drives it towards deep cover for a single.
Quicker, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav cuts it away towards deep cover for a single.
Another fuller ball, around middle. Deepak Hooda eases it down to long off and rotates the strike.
Slower through the air, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav knocks it down to long off. One run taken.
Tad shorter, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav defends it out solidly.
Flatter, around off. Deepak Hooda pushes it towards mid on. No run there.
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Suryakumar Yadav knocks it down to mid on for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav stays back and guides it towards point.
Fuller ball, spinning it away from outside off. Deepak Hooda pushes it towards deep cover. One run taken.
Loopy ball, full in length. Suryakumar Yadav eases it down to long off for a single.
Quicker one, around the middle. Deepak Hooda stays in his crease and works it away towards square leg for a single.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Deepak Hooda flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Floated delivery, around middle and off. Suryakumar Yadav knocks it towards cover.
Quicker this time, around off. Deepak Hooda pushes it towards cover for a single.
Touch fuller, on middle. Deepak Hooda sweeps it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Fabian Allen starts off with a flighted delivery, full ball, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav knocks it towards long off for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He retains the strike. India need 17 runs more to win.
Flighted delivery, full in length, on middle. Suryakumar Yadav prods and blocks it out solidly.
Fuller ball, around off. Suryakumar Yadav defends it out.
Flatter ball, quicker and on middle. Suryakumar Yadav pushes it back to the bowler.
Tosses this one up, full in length. Deepak Hooda works it away towards square leg for a single.
Loopy ball, a low full toss, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav drives it towards deep cover for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, around off. Deepak Hooda defends it out.
FOUR! Lucky boundary! Edgy four ruins a good over! On a length, around middle and off. Deepak Hooda looks to drive this but he gets an outside edge past the keeper for a boundary.
WIDE! Spraying it down the leg side, on a fuller length. Deepak Hooda misses his flick. Wide called.
Change of pace this time. A slower one, outside off, on a length. Deepak Hooda dabs it towards point.
On a length, around the pads. Deepak Hooda clips it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length, outside off. Deepak Hooda dabs it towards third man.
Touch sorter, outside off. Deepak Hooda chops it to the fielder at cover-point.
A beauty to end the over! A loopy ball, this one around middle and off, and turns away sharply. Suryakumar Yadav looks to defend but gets beaten.
Around middle, fuller in length, tosses it up. Suryakumar Yadav prods and defends it out.
An arm ball, quicker, around the pads. Deepak Hooda tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, fuller in length. Deepak Hooda taps it towards point.
Flatter, shorter, quicker. Deepak Hooda pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller ball, on middle. Deepak Hooda defends it out.
Fuller, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav blocks it out.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Jason Holder sprays this down the leg side, on a length. Suryakumar Yadav glances this towards fine leg for a boundary.
Outside off this time, around the pads. Deepak Hooda dabs it to point and rotates the strike.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Deepak Hooda taps it towards mid-wicket. Dot ball.
Length ball, around middle. Deepak Hooda shows the full face of his bat and blocks it out.
Fuller ball, around the pads. Deepak Hooda flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.

FOUR! Oh, dear! Suryakumar Yadav gets away with a lucky boundary! A quicker one, around off. Suryakumar Yadav stays in his crease and looks to cut this away, but gets a slight outside edge just past the keeper, all the way towards the third man fence for a boundary. India 33 runs away now.
Tosses it up, on middle, full in length. Deepak Hooda leans and knocks it towards long on and rotates the strike.
Fuller ball, spinning away from outside off. Deepak Hooda taps it towards point.
Tad quicker, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav, on back foot, pushes it towards long on for a single.
Fuller, slower through the air, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav leans and blocks it out.
Shorter ball, outside off. Deepak Hooda pushes it towards long off for a single.
On off, blocked.
A bye now! Shorter and on middle, Hooda ducks under this one. The ball dips as it gets to the keeper and also swings away, it hits the boot and goes down to third man. A run taken.
FOUR! Shot! On the up and to the fence! Length and on off, Hooda hits it through mid off for a boundary.
Two more! Shorter and on off, this is pulled through square leg for two.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Hooda looks to flick but misses.
On off, this is guided down to third man for one.
A single to end a productive over for India! Angled into middle, Yadav looks to defend but it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
On middle, Yadav defends.

FOUR! Cheeky and risky! Such is the confidence of the man though. Shorter and outside off, Yadav looks to guide it late on the off side, there is a slip in place, he gets it past him and into the third man fence.
FOUR! Lovely sweep shot! Wonderful! On middle, Yadav gets on top of the bounce and sweeps it along the ground through square leg for a boundary.
Hooda is underway in ODI cricket! He drives this full ball through covers for one.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
BEATEN! Shorter and on off, this one straightens after landing. Yadav is beaten as he tries to block.
Two! Angled into the pads, Yadav works it through square leg for two.
On middle, defended.
Deepak Hooda, the debutant, walks out to bat now.

OUT! RUN OUT! Pant has been dismissed in the most unfortunate way! 4 wickets in quick succession for West Indies and this might just bring some belief amongst them. Still 61 runs away are the hosts! Also, this could be signs of the luck changing. This is full and on middle, Yadav strokes it back crisply. Joseph hangs his front foot out, it hits it and goes onto the stumps at the other end. Pant is backing up a long way. He walks back disappointed.
On middle, defended.
Good length and on middle, this one jags back in. Yadav gets an inside edge onto the pads as he tries to block.
Yadav is off the mark! On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On the stumps, blocked.
Suryakumar Yadav comes to the crease now.

OUT! TAKEN! This is a good passage of play for the Windies. Do not think it would make a different to the result of the game but it is something to be happy about. Akeal Hosein now takes one, he gets rid of Ishan Kishan! On the pads, Kishans sweeps but straight to the man at deep square leg. Fabian Allen takes it. Kishan walks back after getting off to a start.
Commentary.Howout: c Fabian Allen b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: A full toss on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is guided to point.
Another dot to end but the damage was done earlier on! On the stumps, this is kept out.
On off, Pant defends it onto the ground.
FOUR! Wonderful shot! Fuller and on off, Pant shows the full face of the bat and times it past mid off for a boundary.
Drop and run! On off, Kishan plays it on the off side and gets to the other end.
SIX! Very clever, top stuff from Kishan! Shorter and on middle, Kishan was ready for it, he upper cuts it over the keeper for a biggie in the third man region.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.

DRINKS! India are going along nicely! They just need the 76 runs and they want to end this quickly. They have played attacking cricket from the word go. West Indies on the other hand, need a couple of overs like Alzarri Joseph bowled. In short, they need a miracle. Will there be one?
Shorter, spinning it back in on middle. Ishan Kishan defends it out.
Slower through the air, full and outside off. Ishan Kishan guides it towards third man for a brace.
Flatter ball, on the stumps. Rishabh Pant clips it towards deep square leg for a single.
Flatter, on middle. Rishabh Pant steps down and pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Edged and four! A loopy ball, full, on middle. Rishabh Pant gets low and sweeps this but he manages to get a top edge past the backward short leg fielder for a boundary.
A shorter ball, around the pads. Ishan Kishan tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, around middle. Rishabh Pant pushes it back to the bowler. End of a successful over by Alzarri Joseph.

OUT! TAKEN! Alzarri Joseph gets another wicket in the over! This time it's Virat Kohli who walks back. After two boundaries, Virat Kohli goes back to the hut. Alzarri Joseph drops it short again, on middle. Virat Kohli goes for the pull, but the ball goes off the top edge towards fine leg. Kemar Roach, there runs forward, gets low and takes a good catch. India lose their second wicket in quick succession.
Commentary.Howout: c Kemar Roach b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter ball, around middle. Virat Kohli ducks underneath it.
WIDE! Spraying it down the leg side, on a length. Virat Kohli looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! A shorter ball, wide of off. Virat Kohli stays in his crease and upper cuts this over deep point for a boundary.
FOUR! Edgy runs! Virat Kohli gets off the mark with that lucky boundary. A length ball, outside off. Virat Kohli looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge past the first fielder for a boundary.
Virat Kohli walks out to bat now!
A huge shout for LBW and the finger is raised. Rohit is adjudged LBW but he reviews. Seems out.

OUT! LBW! Alzarri Joseph draws first blood! He gets the big wicket of Rohit Sharma! India lose their first wicket. A length ball, nipping back in on middle. Rohit Sharma looks to flick but misses and gets rapped on the pads. A huge appeal by West Indies and the umpire raises his finger. Rohit Sharma decides to go for the review! No bat involved confirms UltraEdge, Ball Trackers shows it is the umpire's call on wickets! The on-field decision stands! Rohit Sharma walks back now. He has done his job though. A good return into the team for him.
Shorter one again, spinning it in on the pads. Ishan Kishan goes for the flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls towards fine leg for a single.
Quicker and shorter, outside off. Ishan Kishan hangs back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Outside off, tad shorter. Rohit Sharma pushes it towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Perfect execution! Another fuller in length, outside off. Rohit Sharma gets low and sweeps this towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Beauty! A fuller ball, lands on middle and spins away. Rohit Sharma looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller ball, on middle. Rohit Sharma drives it towards cover. No run there!
Good-length delivery, around the pads. Ishan Kishan looks to flick this away, but he gets a leading edge towards the bowler. 100 needed more off 38 overs!
Wide of off this time, on a length. Rohit Sharma steers it towards deep point for a single.
FOUR! Glorious! A low full toss, on middle. Rohit Sharma presents the full face of the bat and pushes it down the ground for a boundary!
Good-length delivery,, outside off. Rohit Sharma blocks it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Rohit Sharma defends it out.
A length ball, on the pads. Rohit Sharma tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace. FIFTY up for the Indian skipper! A fine 50 for Rohit Sharma on his return!
Shorter ball, lands around off, and turns back in around middle. Ishan Kishan tucks it towards the fielder at short leg. Dot to end the over.
Slower through the air this time, full in length, around middle. Rohit Sharma knocks it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Quicker one, outside off. Rohit Sharma stays back and chops it towards cover-point.
Shorter ball, around middle. Ishan Kishan hangs back and taps it towards fine leg for a single.
Flatter, around the pads. Rohit Sharma works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Beaten! Good start by Akeal Hosein! A fuller ball, lands on middle and spins away and misses the off pole. Rohit Sharma looks to defend but gets beaten.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a total of 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Akeal Hosein comes into the attack.
A single to end a huge over! On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
SIX! That has cleared the fence! Powerful shot by Rohit! Short and on middle, he is unfazed by the short one yet again. He goes back and pulls it well over the square leg fence for a biggie.

FOUR! Nice and fine! Really do not think he intended it to go that fine but he won't mind! Outside off, shorter in length and coming back in. Sharma looks to guide it down to third man but it goes off the edge and down to the third man fence.
Angled in on middle, Sharma plays it with soft hands right under his eyes.
Shorter and on off, Sharma guides it towards point. He wants a run but is sent back in time.
FOUR! Hammered away! Short and on middle, Sharma has enough time to rock back and pull this through mid-wicket for a boundary. India doing it with ease.
A single to end as this is guided down to third man.
On off, this is guided to point.
Outside off, Sharma slashes but misses.
Shorter and around off, this is cut to point.
On the pads, this is worked towards square leg for one more.
Short and on the body, Kishan looks to pull, it goes off the thigh pad down to fine leg for two. Leg byes.
Angled into middle, defended.
FOUR! CRACK! Rohit is in full flow now! Excellent timing! Comes down the track, makes it into a half volley and strokes it over mid off for another boundary.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
That one stays low! Outside off, this does not bounce a lot. Sharma looks to play it on the off side but is beaten by the lack of bounce.
FOUR! Up and over! That is bread and butter stuff for Rohit Sharma! Full and on the pads, he whips it uppishly and over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length and on off, defended.
A dot to end! Shorter and outside off, Kishan cuts but to point.
On off, Kishan pushes it to covers.
On the stumps, Kishan stays back and keeps it out.
FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! India dealing in boundaries now! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled again, not off the middle but away from the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
On middle, Kishan works it to mid-wicket.
Goes short again but this is on the body, well directed. Ducked under.
WIDE! Starts off with a wayward ball, short and well wide outside off. Left alone.
Alzarri Joseph comes into the attack.
FOUR! SHOT! Stand and deliver! On off, on the shorter side, Rohit stands tall, gets on top of the bounce and places it between cover and cover-point for another boundary.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Goes fuller now and on off, Kishan pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Whack! He feeds on such deliveries, short and on middle, he rocks back and pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary. Below 150 needed now.
Good length and on middle, Kishan plays it to mid on.
On the pads, this is flicked but to square leg.
Fuller ball, around middle. Rohit Sharma works it away and finds the fielder at mid-wicket. Dot to end the over!

FOUR! A gift to Rohit Sharma! Fuller length, spraying it down the leg side. Rohit Sharma clips it wide of the keeper, towards the fine leg fence for a boundary! Shouts of catch it but it was far away from Shai Hope behind the stumps.
A fuller length, on the pads. Rohit Sharma clips it between square leg and mid-wicket for a brace.
Tad shorter, on the pads. Ishan Kishan pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Angling it in on middle, on a fuller length. Ishan Kishan leans and blocks it towards mid off.
Kemar Roach serves a length ball, outside off. Rohit Sharma dabs it towards third man and rotates the strike.
Touch shorter, around the pads. Ishan Kishan defends it out. Dot to end the over!
On a length, outside off, this one stays low. Rohit Sharma manages to get an outside edge towards third man for a single.
Outside off, on a length. Rohit Sharma leaves it alone.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rohit Sharma hangs back and dabs it towards point.
FOUR! Perfectly timed shot! An overpitched delivery, on middle. Rohit Sharma presents the full face of the bat and drives it past mid on for a beautiful boundary.
Shorter delivery, outside off. Rohit Sharma taps it to point.
Back of a length, outside off. Ishan Kishan stands tall and pushes it towards point.
A better line this time, outside off, tad shorter. Ishan Kishan will watch it sail through to the keeper.
WIDE! Kemar Roach serves it on a length, wide of off. Ishan Kishan shoulders his arms at it.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Ishan Kishan opens the face of the bat and guides it past point for a couple of runs.
This was one was pitched on a length, shaping away from outside off. Ishan Kishan lets that go through!
Another length ball, outside off. Ishan Kishan offers no shot on that.
WIDE! Good-length delivery, wide of off. Ishan Kishan leaves it alone. Wide called.
A length ball, outside off. Ishan Kishan looks to push this away on the off side, but he gets inside edge on the right of the keeper.
Tad shorter, outside off. Rohit Sharma covers the line of the ball and blocks it out solidly.
Back of a length, this one comes back in on middle. Rohit Sharma misses his flick and gets hit high on the pads.
On a length, shaping away from outside off. Rohit Sharma leaves it alone.
Back of a length, outside off. Rohit Sharma, on back foot, blocks it out.
On a length, on the pads. Rohit Sharma works it towards deep square leg for a brace.

Edged but safe! A fuller ball, outside off. Ishan Kishan looks to drive this, but he gets an outside edge towards first slip. The ball flies and lands just short of the fielder at first slip, who fails to grab the ball on the bounce. One run taken. Ishan Kishan gets off the mark with that.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rohit Sharma pushes it towards mid off. 6 runs off the first over!
Beaten! Tad shorter, outside off. Rohit Sharma looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Rohit Sharma gets off the mark in style!  A fuller delivery, around middle. Rohit Sharma uses his wrists and glances it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
A stifled appeal for LBW< but the umpire is unmoved! A length ball, nipping back in on middle. Rohit Sharma looks to clips this away, but misses and gets hit on high on the pads.
Fuller length, outside off. Rohit Sharma leans and blocks it out.
Another one down the leg side, on a length. Rohit Sharma misses flick one again and wide is called.
WIDE! On a length, spraying it down the leg side. Rohit Sharma looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
Kemar Roach starts with a shorter ball, outside off. Rohit Sharma taps it to cover. No run there!
